# Phase 3 gate: validation results, seed 1 (generated by scripts/select_transforms.py)

**Selection rule.** Lowest validation MAE in original price units per (model, track, horizon); conditions within 1% of the lowest MAE are tied and the simplest is chosen, in the order minmax < log_return < revin. Seed 1 only.

**Caveat.** Sudan validation has only 223 / 217 / 194 windows (h = 1 / 7 / 30), all from one 7-month period (2021-03 → 2021-10) after the 404-day gap, so the Sudan selection is noisy; global validation has 915 / 909 / 886 windows (2017-09 → 2021-05).

Validation only: no test window has been predicted for any run in this table. MAE in price units (SDG/g Sudan, USD/oz global). `epochs` = epochs trained (max 100, early-stopping patience 10 on validation MAE in model space). ★ = selected; † = within 1% of the best (tie).
